facts.fact: The Prime Minister told the National Assembly on 1 March 2026 that agreements between Djibouti Telecom, Ethio telecom and Sudatel for a 2,800 km fibre corridor exist, with Horizon Fiber launching to link Djibouti to Ethiopia and South Sudan; no construction is stated.
